title: WarioWare: Move It!
subtitle: A holiday interrupted by a few seconds of panic
summary: WarioWare: Move It! is Intelligent Systems' party game, released for Nintendo Switch on 3 November 2023.
body: WarioWare: Move It! is Intelligent Systems' party game, released for Nintendo Switch on 3 November 2023. Wario and his friends travel to Caresaway Island, where the Joy-Con become Form Stones used in a succession of very short games. Following the motion-based approach of WarioWare: Smooth Moves, the player changes posture before each activity and then reacts to a brief command. More than two hundred microgames turn familiar gestures into sudden tests of understanding, timing and willingness to look a little ridiculous.

A form establishes how to hold the controllers before a microgame starts. The next instruction then asks the player to perform an action from that position, sometimes using the right Joy-Con's infrared camera as well as motion sensors. Each activity lasts only seconds, so recognising what the image and command mean is part of the challenge. A failed response costs a life, and consecutive successes lead towards a longer boss game that develops the current sequence into a more sustained task.

Two-player cooperation asks partners to synchronise their movements, while party modes offer other ways for a group to compete. The island holiday gives each WarioWare character a short comic situation around their selection of games. Jo Kondo, Haruno Ito and Shomo Murata composed the music. Move It! makes the players' bodies part of the spectacle: the screen gives a minimal prompt, but the shared experience also includes watching someone work out the gesture and attempt it before the moment has passed.
